_note: Every model-free fact this registration rests on, and the CANONICAL stage3_measurement mapping (run id -> block) scripts/checks/stage3_effect_floor_check.py resolves; this copy has precedence over the preregistration's fence.
no_lock: Earnings-22 has no locked system and no direct parent cell: the shared direct layer e22-native-window-direct-base-v1 (the phase-direct-only-v1 program and its one phase_material.direct entry, the generic transcription instruction bytes shared with E21) is the whole comparator, so the module's all-off arm is that base fragment plus the E21-shaped native-window geometry and pins on the Earnings-22 dev split. No knowledge supply, no ConEC layer, no entity scorer, no analytical tool.
not_registered: No component-on cell for this carrier (decision 187 keeps the GPU on SLURP; a component turns on per carrier only through its own read, design 2b.3 item 4).
own_null: Earnings-22 has NO measured own null on this form (no cell has ever flown on the native-window dev form); the module null is unmeasured until an in-chain A/A of this arm seals (design 2b.3). The all-off arm is therefore a form proof only, and no benefit may be claimed on this carrier until that A/A exists.

pending_pins.knowledge_snapshot: inert placeholder snapshot (one facet, one value, bound to no sample) pinned in both baselines; bound invisibly by the knowledge-none direct phase
pending_pins.prepared_window_feature_packets: all-zero sha256 placeholder in both baseline fragments: the Earnings-22 dev window feature packets do not exist; they need an encoder pass (root lease, GPU, registration, owner authorization). Producing them changes both composed config hashes, so root re-runs this script (or the repin tool) afterwards.
pending_pins.serving_session: serving-e22-native-window-flightruntime-np4-max1024-v1 is a NEW session name: its feature root differs from the resident E21 session, so no resident session serves it

SAEA-EARNINGS22-NATIVE-STAGE3-MODULE-ALL.note: Form proof of the consumption module's carrier admission gate (design 2b.3): the all-off arm is the carrier's direct baseline bytes; nothing is expected to move and no benefit is claimed.
SAEA-EARNINGS22-NATIVE-STAGE3-MODULE-ALL.primary_metric: asr-wer-whisper only (corpus-level Whisper English-normalizer WER, the paper-facing metric; no ConEC, entity or numeric layer exists for Earnings-22). Scorer variant: the PLAIN window-form scorer, NOT the ESB short-form tail-2 s variant of docs/readiness/2026-09-05-scoring-alignment-conclusions.md (15.937 sealed vs 9.2377 under the 2.0 s digital-silence tail, deviation D-TS2-3): this cell appends no tail silence, reads whole 90 s windows of whole dev calls rather than ESB test utterances, and so none of 15.937 / 9.2377 / 9.79 / 12.3 is a comparator and no alignment band is claimed
SAEA-EARNINGS22-NATIVE-STAGE3-MODULE-ALL.read_roster: Earnings-22 whole dev split, 10 calls / 451 native windows (split identity 89b178d6...)
